CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_trans_recalcular
  @DOC NVARCHAR(255)
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  UPDATE h
  SET h.CTD = ISNULL(calc.CTD, 0),
      h.IMP = ISNULL(calc.IMP, 0),
      h.FCNC = COALESCE(h.FCNC, CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))),
      h.FCNM = CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))
  FROM dbo.TRAN_CTR_DOCPRE h
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) = -1 THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, d.CTD), 0) END) AS CTD,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) = -1 THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, d.CTD), 0) * ISNULL(a.CTOP, 0) END) AS IMP
    FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DAT_ART a
      ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(h.SUC_SAL, h.ALM_SAL)))
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ART, '')))
    WHERE d.DOC = h.DOC
  ) calc
  WHERE h.DOC = @DOC;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_trans_contabilizar
  @DOC NVARCHAR(255),
  @USER NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  SET XACT_ABORT ON;

  BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @sucSal NVARCHAR(20), @sucEnt NVARCHAR(20), @estatus NVARCHAR(30), @docBase BIGINT;
    SELECT
      @sucSal = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(SUC_SAL, ALM_SAL))),
      @sucEnt = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(SUC_ENT, ALM_ENT))),
      @estatus = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(ESTATUS, ''))))
    FROM dbo.TRAN_CTR_DOCPRE WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE DOC = @DOC;

    IF @estatus IS NULL THROW 59170, 'Documento no existe.', 1;
    IF @estatus NOT IN ('REVISANDO', 'INCIDENCIA') THROW 59171, 'Solo se puede contabilizar desde REVISANDO o INCIDENCIA.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART
      WHERE DOC = @DOC
        AND ISNULL(BLOQ, 0) <> -1
        AND (CTD_R IS NULL OR UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(ESTATUS_R, '')))) NOT IN ('CONTABILIZADO', 'INCIDENCIA'))
    )
      THROW 59173, 'Todos los articulos deben tener cantidad recibida y estatus CONTABILIZADO o INCIDENCIA.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART
      WHERE DOC = @DOC
        AND ISNULL(BLOQ, 0) <> -1
        AND FCN_CONT IS NULL
        AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'CONTABILIZADO'
    )
      THROW 59174, 'No hay articulos pendientes marcados como CONTABILIZADO para afectar inventario.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.DAT_CMOV WHERE CMOV IN (122, 123, 124) HAVING COUNT(*) = 3)
      THROW 59172, 'DAT_CMOV no tiene configurados los movimientos 122, 123 y 124.', 1;

    SELECT @docBase = TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, NDOC)
    FROM dbo.DAT_CMOV WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE CMOV = 123;
    IF @docBase IS NULL SET @docBase = 123000000;
    SET @docBase = @docBase + 1;
    UPDATE dbo.DAT_CMOV SET NDOC = @docBase WHERE CMOV = 123;

    INSERT INTO dbo.DAT_MB51
      (IDPD, [USER], CLSM, DOCP, ART, CTDA, CTOT, FCND, FCNC, TXT, ALMACEN, VTAESP, SUC)
    SELECT
      CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), NEWID()), @USER, 123, @DOC, d.ART,
      ISNULL(d.CTD_R, 0),
      ISNULL(d.CTD_R, 0) * ISNULL(aDest.CTOP, aOrig.CTOP),
      CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME())), CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME())), CONCAT('TRANSFERENCIA ENTRADA DOC ', @DOC),
      '001', 0, @sucEnt
    FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DAT_ART aDest
      ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(aDest.SUC, ''))) = @sucEnt
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(aDest.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ART, '')))
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DAT_ART aOrig
      ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(aOrig.SUC, ''))) = @sucSal
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(aOrig.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ART, '')))
    WHERE d.DOC = @DOC
      AND ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) <> -1
      AND d.FCN_CONT IS NULL
      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'CONTABILIZADO'
      AND ISNULL(d.CTD_R, 0) > 0;

    UPDATE a
    SET a.STOCK = ISNULL(a.STOCK, 0) + ISNULL(d.CTD_R, 0)
    FROM dbo.DAT_ART a
    JOIN dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
      ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ART, '')))
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, ''))) = @sucEnt
    WHERE d.DOC = @DOC
      AND ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) <> -1
      AND d.FCN_CONT IS NULL
      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'CONTABILIZADO';

    INSERT INTO dbo.DAT_MB51
      (IDPD, [USER], CLSM, DOCP, ART, CTDA, CTOT, FCND, FCNC, TXT, ALMACEN, VTAESP, SUC)
    SELECT
      CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), NEWID()), @USER, 122, @DOC, d.ART,
      ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0),
      ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0) * ISNULL(a.CTOP, 0),
      CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME())), CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME())), CONCAT('TRANSFERENCIA FALTANTE DOC ', @DOC),
      '001', 0, @sucSal
    FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DAT_ART a
      ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, ''))) = @sucSal
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ART, '')))
    WHERE d.DOC = @DOC
      AND ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) <> -1
      AND d.FCN_CONT IS NULL
      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'CONTABILIZADO'
      AND ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0) > 0;

    UPDATE a
    SET a.STOCK = ISNULL(a.STOCK, 0) + ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0)
    FROM dbo.DAT_ART a
    JOIN dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
      ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ART, '')))
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, ''))) = @sucSal
    WHERE d.DOC = @DOC
      AND ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) <> -1
      AND d.FCN_CONT IS NULL
      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'CONTABILIZADO'
      AND ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0) > 0;

    INSERT INTO dbo.DAT_MB51
      (IDPD, [USER], CLSM, DOCP, ART, CTDA, CTOT, FCND, FCNC, TXT, ALMACEN, VTAESP, SUC)
    SELECT
      CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), NEWID()), @USER, 124, @DOC, d.ART,
      -ABS(ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0)),
      -ABS(ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0)) * ISNULL(a.CTOP, 0),
      CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME())), CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME())), CONCAT('TRANSFERENCIA SOBRANTE DOC ', @DOC),
      '001', 0, @sucSal
    FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DAT_ART a
      ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, ''))) = @sucSal
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ART, '')))
    WHERE d.DOC = @DOC
      AND ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) <> -1
      AND d.FCN_CONT IS NULL
      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'CONTABILIZADO'
      AND ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0) < 0;

    UPDATE a
    SET a.STOCK = ISNULL(a.STOCK, 0) - ABS(ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0))
    FROM dbo.DAT_ART a
    JOIN dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
      ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ART, '')))
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, ''))) = @sucSal
    WHERE d.DOC = @DOC
      AND ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) <> -1
      AND d.FCN_CONT IS NULL
      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'CONTABILIZADO'
      AND ISNULL(d.DIF_R, 0) < 0;

    UPDATE dbo.TRAN_DET_ART
    SET FCN_CONT = CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME())),
        USR_CONT = @USER
    WHERE DOC = @DOC
      AND ISNULL(BLOQ, 0) <> -1
      AND FCN_CONT IS NULL
      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'CONTABILIZADO';

    UPDATE h
    SET h.ESTATUS = CASE
          WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
            WHERE d.DOC = h.DOC
              AND ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) <> -1
              AND d.FCN_CONT IS NULL
              AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'INCIDENCIA'
          ) THEN 'INCIDENCIA'
          ELSE 'CONTABILIZADO'
        END,
        h.DOC_MB51_ENT = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @docBase),
        h.CTD = calc.CTD,
        h.IMP = calc.IMP,
        h.FCNC = CASE
          WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
            WHERE d.DOC = h.DOC
              AND ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) <> -1
              AND d.FCN_CONT IS NULL
              AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ESTATUS_R, '')))) = 'INCIDENCIA'
          ) THEN CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))
          ELSE h.FCNC
        END,
        h.FCNM = CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))
    FROM dbo.TRAN_CTR_DOCPRE h
    CROSS APPLY (
      SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) = -1 OR d.FCN_CONT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(d.CTD_R, 0) END) AS CTD,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.BLOQ, 0) = -1 OR d.FCN_CONT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(d.CTO_R, 0) END) AS IMP
      FROM dbo.TRAN_DET_ART d
      WHERE d.DOC = h.DOC
    ) calc
    WHERE h.DOC = @DOC;

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT DOC, ESTATUS, DOC_MB51_ENT FROM dbo.TRAN_CTR_DOCPRE WHERE DOC = @DOC;
  END TRY
  BEGIN CATCH
    IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    THROW;
  END CATCH
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_cg_resumen_transacciones_opv
  @SUC VARCHAR(25),
  @FCN DATE,
  @OPV NVARCHAR(255),
  @TIPO_CORTE VARCHAR(10) = 'GLOBAL'
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @sucNorm VARCHAR(25) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@SUC, ''))));
  DECLARE @opvNorm NVARCHAR(255) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@OPV, ''))));
  DECLARE @tipoNorm VARCHAR(10) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@TIPO_CORTE, 'GLOBAL'))));
  DECLARE @fcnDate DATE = ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, @FCN), CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))));
  DECLARE @dtIni DATETIME = CAST(@fcnDate AS DATETIME);
  DECLARE @dtFin DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @dtIni);

  IF @tipoNorm NOT IN ('CA', 'VF', 'GLOBAL')
    SET @tipoNorm = 'GLOBAL';

  IF @sucNorm = ''
    THROW 58040, 'SUC es obligatorio', 1;

  IF @opvNorm = ''
    THROW 58041, 'OPV es obligatorio', 1;

  ;WITH FoliosBase AS (
    SELECT
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ORIGEN_AUT, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL THEN a.ORIGEN_AUT
          ELSE a.AUT
        END,
      '')))) AS TIPO_REF,
      ISNULL(a.IMPT, 0) AS IMPT,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.OPVM, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL THEN a.OPVM
          ELSE a.OPV
        END,
      '')))) AS OPV_REF,
      a.IDFOL
    FROM dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_FORM f
    INNER JOIN dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_ASVR a
      ON a.IDFOL = f.IDFOL
    WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, '')))) = @sucNorm
      AND f.FCN >= @dtIni
      AND f.FCN < @dtFin
  ),
  Folios AS (
    SELECT
      fb.TIPO_REF AS AUT,
      fb.IMPT,
      fb.IDFOL
    FROM FoliosBase fb
    WHERE fb.OPV_REF = @opvNorm
      AND fb.TIPO_REF NOT IN ('CP', 'CPF', 'VA')
      AND (
        @tipoNorm = 'GLOBAL'
        OR (@tipoNorm = 'CA' AND fb.TIPO_REF = 'CA')
        OR (@tipoNorm = 'VF' AND fb.TIPO_REF = 'VF')
      )
    GROUP BY fb.TIPO_REF, fb.IMPT, fb.IDFOL
  )
  SELECT
    f.AUT,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.[DESC], ''))), ''), f.AUT) AS [DESC],
    COUNT(1) AS CTA,
    SUM(ISNULL(f.IMPT, 0)) AS TOTAL,
    @tipoNorm AS TIPO_CORTE
  FROM Folios f
  LEFT JOIN dbo.PV_TIPO_ESTA t
    ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.TIPO, '')))) = f.AUT
  GROUP BY
    f.AUT,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.[DESC], ''))), ''), f.AUT)
  ORDER BY f.AUT;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_cg_resumen_ventas_departamento_opv
  @SUC VARCHAR(25),
  @FCN DATE,
  @OPV NVARCHAR(255),
  @TIPO_CORTE VARCHAR(10) = 'GLOBAL'
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @sucNorm VARCHAR(25) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@SUC, ''))));
  DECLARE @opvNorm NVARCHAR(255) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@OPV, ''))));
  DECLARE @tipoNorm VARCHAR(10) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@TIPO_CORTE, 'GLOBAL'))));
  DECLARE @fcnDate DATE = ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, @FCN), CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))));
  DECLARE @dtIni DATETIME = CAST(@fcnDate AS DATETIME);
  DECLARE @dtFin DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @dtIni);

  IF @tipoNorm NOT IN ('CA', 'VF', 'GLOBAL')
    SET @tipoNorm = 'GLOBAL';

  IF @sucNorm = ''
    THROW 58050, 'SUC es obligatorio', 1;

  IF @opvNorm = ''
    THROW 58051, 'OPV es obligatorio', 1;

  ;WITH FoliosBase AS (
    SELECT
      a.IDFOL,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.AUT, '')))) AS AUT,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ORIGEN_AUT, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL THEN a.ORIGEN_AUT
          ELSE a.AUT
        END,
      '')))) AS TIPO_REF,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.OPVM, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL THEN a.OPVM
          ELSE a.OPV
        END,
      '')))) AS OPV_REF
    FROM dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_FORM f
    INNER JOIN dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_ASVR a
      ON a.IDFOL = f.IDFOL
    WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, '')))) = @sucNorm
      AND f.FCN >= @dtIni
      AND f.FCN < @dtFin
  ),
  Folios AS (
    SELECT
      fb.IDFOL,
      fb.AUT,
      fb.TIPO_REF
    FROM FoliosBase fb
    WHERE fb.OPV_REF = @opvNorm
      AND fb.TIPO_REF NOT IN ('CP', 'CPF', 'VA')
      AND (
        @tipoNorm = 'GLOBAL'
        OR (@tipoNorm = 'CA' AND fb.TIPO_REF = 'CA')
        OR (@tipoNorm = 'VF' AND fb.TIPO_REF = 'VF')
      )
    GROUP BY fb.IDFOL, fb.AUT, fb.TIPO_REF
  )
  SELECT
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.DDEPA, ''))), ''), 'SIN DEPARTAMENTO') AS DDEPA,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.DSUBD, ''))), ''), 'SIN SUBDEPARTAMENTO') AS DSUBD,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.TIPO_REF IN ('DF', 'CD') THEN -ABS(ISNULL(t.CTD, 0)) ELSE ISNULL(t.CTD, 0) END) AS VTAPZS,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN f.TIPO_REF IN ('DF', 'CD') THEN -ABS(ISNULL(t.PVTAT, ISNULL(t.CTD, 0) * ISNULL(t.PVTA, 0)))
        ELSE ISNULL(t.PVTAT, ISNULL(t.CTD, 0) * ISNULL(t.PVTA, 0))
      END
    ) AS VTAPSOS,
    @tipoNorm AS TIPO_CORTE
  FROM Folios f
  INNER JOIN dbo.PV_TICKET_LOG t
    ON t.IDFOL = f.IDFOL
  LEFT JOIN dbo.DAT_ART a
    ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, '')))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.ART, ''))))
   AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, '')))) = @sucNorm
  LEFT JOIN dbo.JRQ_DEPA d
    ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.DEPA, '')))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.DEPA, ''))))
  LEFT JOIN dbo.JRQ_SUBD s
    ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.SUBD, '')))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUBD, ''))))
  GROUP BY
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.DDEPA, ''))), ''), 'SIN DEPARTAMENTO'),
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.DSUBD, ''))), ''), 'SIN SUBDEPARTAMENTO')
  HAVING
    ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN f.TIPO_REF IN ('DF', 'CD') THEN -ABS(ISNULL(t.CTD, 0)) ELSE ISNULL(t.CTD, 0) END)) > 0.000001
    OR ABS(SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN f.TIPO_REF IN ('DF', 'CD') THEN -ABS(ISNULL(t.PVTAT, ISNULL(t.CTD, 0) * ISNULL(t.PVTA, 0)))
        ELSE ISNULL(t.PVTAT, ISNULL(t.CTD, 0) * ISNULL(t.PVTA, 0))
      END
    )) > 0.000001
  ORDER BY DDEPA, DSUBD;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_cg_opv_pendientes
  @SUC VARCHAR(25),
  @FCN DATE,
  @TIPO_CORTE VARCHAR(10) = 'GLOBAL'
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @sucNorm VARCHAR(25) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@SUC, ''))));
  DECLARE @tipoNorm VARCHAR(10) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@TIPO_CORTE, 'GLOBAL'))));
  DECLARE @fcnDate DATE = ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, @FCN), CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))));
  DECLARE @dtIni DATETIME = CAST(@fcnDate AS DATETIME);
  DECLARE @dtFin DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @dtIni);
  DECLARE @serial INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, '1899-12-30', @fcnDate);

  IF @tipoNorm NOT IN ('CA', 'VF', 'GLOBAL')
    SET @tipoNorm = 'GLOBAL';

  IF @sucNorm = ''
    THROW 58070, 'SUC es obligatorio', 1;

  ;WITH FoliosBase AS (
    SELECT
      a.IDFOL,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.OPVM, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL THEN a.OPVM
          ELSE a.OPV
        END,
      '')))) AS OPV,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ORIGEN_AUT, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL THEN a.ORIGEN_AUT
          ELSE a.AUT
        END,
      '')))) AS TIPO_REF,
      ISNULL(a.IMPT, 0) AS IMPT
    FROM dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_FORM f
    INNER JOIN dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_ASVR a
      ON a.IDFOL = f.IDFOL
    WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, '')))) = @sucNorm
      AND f.FCN >= @dtIni
      AND f.FCN < @dtFin
  ),
  Folios AS (
    SELECT
      fb.IDFOL,
      fb.OPV,
      fb.IMPT
    FROM FoliosBase fb
    WHERE fb.TIPO_REF NOT IN ('CP', 'CPF', 'VA')
      AND (
        @tipoNorm = 'GLOBAL'
        OR (@tipoNorm = 'CA' AND fb.TIPO_REF = 'CA')
        OR (@tipoNorm = 'VF' AND fb.TIPO_REF = 'VF')
      )
    GROUP BY fb.IDFOL, fb.OPV, fb.IMPT
  ),
  Agregado AS (
    SELECT
      fb.OPV,
      COUNT(1) AS TRN,
      SUM(ISNULL(fb.IMPT, 0)) AS TOTAL
    FROM Folios fb
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(fb.OPV, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY fb.OPV
  )
  SELECT
    ag.OPV,
    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(
      ISNULL(o.NOMB, '') +
      CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(o.APELP, ''))), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(o.APELP, ''))) END +
      CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(o.APELM, ''))), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(o.APELM, ''))) END
    )), '') AS OPV_NOMBRE,
    ag.TRN,
    ag.TOTAL,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(fin.ESTA, ''))), ''), 'ABIERTA') AS ESTA_ENTREGA,
    ISNULL(fin.IDE, CONCAT(@serial, ag.OPV)) AS IDE,
    @tipoNorm AS TIPO_CORTE
  FROM Agregado ag
  LEFT JOIN dbo.PV_OPV o
    ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(o.IDOPV, '')))) = ag.OPV
  LEFT JOIN dbo.DAT_FORM_FIN fin
    ON fin.IDE = CONCAT(@serial, ag.OPV)
  WHERE ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(fin.ESTA, ''))), ''), 'ABIERTA') <> 'CERRADO'
  ORDER BY ag.OPV;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_promo_evaluar_folio
  @IDFOL NVARCHAR(255)
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @SUC NVARCHAR(255) = '';
  DECLARE @CLIENTE FLOAT = NULL;

  SELECT TOP 1
    @SUC = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(f.SUC, ''))),
    @CLIENTE = TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, f.CLIEN)
  FROM dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_ASVR f
  WHERE f.IDFOL = @IDFOL OR f.IDFOLINICIAL = @IDFOL
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.IDFOL = @IDFOL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ISNULL(f.FCNM, f.FCN) DESC;

  IF @SUC = ''
  BEGIN
    SELECT CAST(0 AS INT) AS total_registros WHERE 1 = 0;
    RETURN;
  END;

  ;WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      t.ID,
      t.IDFOL,
      t.ART,
      t.UPC,
      ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, t.PVTAT), ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, t.CTD), 0) * ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, t.PVTA), 0)) AS PVTAT,
      a.DEPA,
      a.SUBD,
      a.CLAS,
      a.SCLA,
      a.SCLA2,
      jr.GUIA
    FROM dbo.PV_TICKET_LOG t
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DAT_ART a
      ON a.SUC = @SUC
     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.ART, '')))
    OUTER APPLY (
      SELECT TOP 1 j.GUIA
      FROM dbo.DAT_DET_JRQ_SVR j
      WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(j.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.ART, '')))
        AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(j.SUC, ''))) = @SUC OR ISNULL(j.SUC, '') = '')
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(j.SUC, ''))) = @SUC THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    ) jr
    WHERE t.IDFOL = @IDFOL
  )
  SELECT
    b.ID,
    b.IDFOL,
    b.ART,
    b.UPC,
    b.PVTAT,
    c.ID_PROM,
    c.DESC_PROMO,
    c.T_PROM,
    rb.ID_BENEFICIO,
    rb.T_BENEFICIO,
    rb.PRC_DESC,
    rb.IMP_DESC,
    rb.ART_GRATIS,
    rb.UPC_GRATIS,
    rb.CANT_GRATIS,
    rb.PRECIO_GRATIS,
    rb.PRIORIDAD,
    rb.ACUMULABLE
  FROM base b
  INNER JOIN dbo.PROMO_CAB c
    ON (c.EST IN (1, -1) OR c.EST IS NULL)
   AND (c.FCN_INI IS NULL OR CONVERT(DATE, c.FCN_INI) <= CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))))
   AND (c.FCN_TER IS NULL OR CONVERT(DATE, c.FCN_TER) >= CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))))
   AND (
        LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(c.SUC, ''))) = ''
        OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(c.SUC, ''))) = '*'
        OR CHARINDEX(
             ',' + UPPER(@SUC) + ',',
             ',' + REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(c.SUC, '')))), ' ', ''), ';', ',') + ','
           ) > 0
       )
  INNER JOIN dbo.PROMO_REGLA_BENEFICIO rb
    ON rb.ID_PROM = c.ID_PROM
   AND rb.EST = 1
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.PROMO_REGLA_CRITERIO rc
    WHERE rc.ID_PROM = c.ID_PROM
      AND rc.EST = 1
      AND (
           LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.SUC, ''))) = ''
           OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.SUC, ''))) = '*'
           OR CHARINDEX(
                ',' + UPPER(@SUC) + ',',
                ',' + REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.SUC, '')))), ' ', ''), ';', ',') + ','
              ) > 0
          )
      AND (rc.CLIENTE IS NULL OR rc.CLIENTE = @CLIENTE)
      AND (rc.DEPA IS NULL OR rc.DEPA = b.DEPA)
      AND (rc.SUBD IS NULL OR rc.SUBD = b.SUBD)
      AND (rc.CLAS IS NULL OR rc.CLAS = b.CLAS)
      AND (rc.SCLA IS NULL OR rc.SCLA = b.SCLA)
      AND (rc.SCLA2 IS NULL OR rc.SCLA2 = b.SCLA2)
      AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.GUIA, ''))) = '' OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.GUIA, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.GUIA, ''))))
      AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.ART, ''))) = '' OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.ART, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.ART, ''))))
      AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.UPC, ''))) = '' OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(rc.UPC, ''))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.UPC, ''))))
  )
  ORDER BY rb.PRIORIDAD ASC, c.PRIORIDAD ASC, c.ID_PROM ASC;
END;

decisions.context: AND (c.FCN_INI IS NULL OR CONVERT(DATE, c.FCN_INI) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()))
AND (c.FCN_TER IS NULL OR CONVERT(DATE, c.FCN_TER) >= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()))

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_sugeridos_calcular
  @SUC NVARCHAR(20),
  @PROV INT = NULL,
  @MARCA NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
  @TIPO NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
  @DEPA NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
  @SUBD NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
  @CLAS NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
  @SCLA NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
  @SCLA2 NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
  @DIAS INT = 90,
  @PAGE INT = 1,
  @LIMIT INT = 100
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @sucNorm NVARCHAR(20) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@SUC, N''))));
  DECLARE @sucMov VARCHAR(20) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), @sucNorm);
  DECLARE @marcaNorm NVARCHAR(100) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@MARCA, N''))));
  DECLARE @tipoNorm NVARCHAR(80) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@TIPO, N''))));

  IF @sucNorm = N''
  BEGIN
    THROW 51000, 'La sucursal es requerida para calcular sugeridos.', 1;
  END;

  IF @DIAS IS NULL OR @DIAS <= 0 SET @DIAS = 90;
  IF @PAGE IS NULL OR @PAGE <= 0 SET @PAGE = 1;
  IF @LIMIT IS NULL OR @LIMIT <= 0 SET @LIMIT = 100;
  IF @LIMIT > 500 SET @LIMIT = 500;

  DECLARE @offset INT = (@PAGE - 1) * @LIMIT;
  DECLARE @fechaHasta DATETIME = CONVERT(DATETIME, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))), MONTH(CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))), 1));
  DECLARE @fechaDesde DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, -@DIAS, @fechaHasta);

  CREATE TABLE #f_depa (VAL FLOAT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);
  CREATE TABLE #f_subd (VAL FLOAT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);
  CREATE TABLE #f_clas (VAL FLOAT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);
  CREATE TABLE #f_scla (VAL FLOAT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);
  CREATE TABLE #f_scla2 (VAL FLOAT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);

  INSERT INTO #f_depa (VAL)
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value)))
  FROM STRING_SPLIT(ISNULL(@DEPA, N''), N',')
  WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) IS NOT NULL;

  INSERT INTO #f_subd (VAL)
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value)))
  FROM STRING_SPLIT(ISNULL(@SUBD, N''), N',')
  WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) IS NOT NULL;

  INSERT INTO #f_clas (VAL)
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value)))
  FROM STRING_SPLIT(ISNULL(@CLAS, N''), N',')
  WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) IS NOT NULL;

  INSERT INTO #f_scla (VAL)
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value)))
  FROM STRING_SPLIT(ISNULL(@SCLA, N''), N',')
  WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) IS NOT NULL;

  INSERT INTO #f_scla2 (VAL)
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value)))
  FROM STRING_SPLIT(ISNULL(@SCLA2, N''), N',')
  WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) IS NOT NULL;

  DECLARE @hasDepa BIT = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_depa) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  DECLARE @hasSubd BIT = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_subd) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  DECLARE @hasClas BIT = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_clas) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  DECLARE @hasScla BIT = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_scla) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  DECLARE @hasScla2 BIT = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_scla2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

  CREATE TABLE #art_base (
    ART NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    SUC NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    TIPO NVARCHAR(510) NULL,
    UPC NVARCHAR(510) NULL,
    DES NVARCHAR(510) NULL,
    BASE NVARCHAR(510) NULL,
    SPH FLOAT NULL,
    CYL FLOAT NULL,
    ADIC FLOAT NULL,
    STOCK_MIN FLOAT NOT NULL,
    ESTATUS NVARCHAR(510) NULL,
    DIA_REABASTO FLOAT NOT NULL,
    PVTA MONEY NULL,
    CTOP MONEY NULL,
    PROV_1 FLOAT NULL,
    CTO_PROV1 MONEY NULL,
    PROV_2 FLOAT NULL,
    CTO_PROV2 MONEY NULL,
    PROV_3 FLOAT NULL,
    CTO_PROV3 MONEY NULL,
    UN_COMP NVARCHAR(510) NULL,
    FACT_COMP FLOAT NOT NULL,
    MARCA NVARCHAR(510) NULL,
    DEPA FLOAT NULL,
    SUBD FLOAT NULL,
    CLAS FLOAT NULL,
    SCLA FLOAT NULL,
    SCLA2 FLOAT NULL
  );

  IF @hasDepa = 0 AND @hasSubd = 0 AND @hasClas = 0 AND @hasScla = 0 AND @hasScla2 = 0
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #art_base (
      ART, SUC, TIPO, UPC, DES, BASE, SPH, CYL, ADIC, STOCK_MIN, ESTATUS,
      DIA_REABASTO, PVTA, CTOP, PROV_1, CTO_PROV1, PROV_2, CTO_PROV2,
      PROV_3, CTO_PROV3, UN_COMP, FACT_COMP, MARCA, DEPA, SUBD, CLAS, SCLA, SCLA2
    )
    SELECT
      CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, N'')))) AS ART,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, N'')))) AS SUC,
      a.TIPO,
      a.UPC,
      a.DES,
      a.BASE,
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SPH),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.CYL),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.ADIC),
      ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.STOCK_MIN), 0),
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ESTATUS, N'')))),
      ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.DIA_REABASTO), 0),
      TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.PVTA),
      TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.CTOP),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.PROV_1),
      TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.CTO_PROV1),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.PROV_2),
      TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.CTO_PROV2),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.PROV_3),
      TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.CTO_PROV3),
      a.UN_COMP,
      CASE WHEN ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.FACT_COMP), 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.FACT_COMP) END,
      a.MARCA,
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.DEPA),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SUBD),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.CLAS),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SCLA),
      TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SCLA2)
    FROM dbo.DAT_ART a
    WHERE a.SUC = @sucNorm
      AND ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.BLOQ), 0) = 0
      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ESTATUS, N'')))) NOT IN (N'NO RESURTIBLE', N'NO RESURTIDO')
      AND (@marcaNorm = N'' OR UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.MARCA, N'')))) LIKE N'%' + @marcaNorm + N'%')
      AND (@tipoNorm = N'' OR UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.TIPO, N'')))) = @tipoNorm)
      AND (
        @PROV IS NULL
        OR TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.PROV_1) = @PROV
        OR TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.PROV_2) = @PROV
        OR TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.PROV_3) = @PROV
      )
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
  DECLARE @insertArtSql NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
  INSERT INTO #art_base (
    ART, SUC, TIPO, UPC, DES, BASE, SPH, CYL, ADIC, STOCK_MIN, ESTATUS,
    DIA_REABASTO, PVTA, CTOP, PROV_1, CTO_PROV1, PROV_2, CTO_PROV2,
    PROV_3, CTO_PROV3, UN_COMP, FACT_COMP, MARCA, DEPA, SUBD, CLAS, SCLA, SCLA2
  )
  SELECT
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ART, N'''')))) AS ART,
    UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, N'''')))) AS SUC,
    a.TIPO,
    a.UPC,
    a.DES,
    a.BASE,
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SPH),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.CYL),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.ADIC),
    ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.STOCK_MIN), 0),
    UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ESTATUS, N'''')))),
    ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.DIA_REABASTO), 0),
    TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.PVTA),
    TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.CTOP),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.PROV_1),
    TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.CTO_PROV1),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.PROV_2),
    TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.CTO_PROV2),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.PROV_3),
    TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, a.CTO_PROV3),
    a.UN_COMP,
    CASE WHEN ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.FACT_COMP), 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.FACT_COMP) END,
    a.MARCA,
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.DEPA),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SUBD),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.CLAS),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SCLA),
    TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SCLA2)
  FROM dbo.DAT_ART a
  WHERE a.SUC = @pSuc
    AND ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.BLOQ), 0) = 0
    AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ESTATUS, N'''')))) NOT IN (N''NO RESURTIBLE'', N''NO RESURTIDO'')
    AND (@pMarca = N'''' OR UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.MARCA, N'''')))) LIKE N''%'' + @pMarca + N''%'')
    AND (@pTipo = N'''' OR UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.TIPO, N'''')))) = @pTipo)
    AND (
      @pProv IS NULL
      OR TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.PROV_1) = @pProv
      OR TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.PROV_2) = @pProv
      OR TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.PROV_3) = @pProv
    )';

  IF @hasDepa = 1 SET @insertArtSql += N'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_depa f WHERE f.VAL = TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.DEPA))';
  IF @hasSubd = 1 SET @insertArtSql += N'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_subd f WHERE f.VAL = TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SUBD))';
  IF @hasClas = 1 SET @insertArtSql += N'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_clas f WHERE f.VAL = TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.CLAS))';
  IF @hasScla = 1 SET @insertArtSql += N'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_scla f WHERE f.VAL = TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SCLA))';
  IF @hasScla2 = 1 SET @insertArtSql += N'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #f_scla2 f WHERE f.VAL = TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, a.SCLA2))';

  SET @insertArtSql += N'
  OPTION (RECOMPILE);';

  EXEC sp_executesql
    @insertArtSql,
    N'@pSuc NVARCHAR(20), @pMarca NVARCHAR(100), @pTipo NVARCHAR(80), @pProv INT',
    @pSuc = @sucNorm,
    @pMarca = @marcaNorm,
    @pTipo = @tipoNorm,
    @pProv = @PROV;
  END

  CREATE INDEX IX_art_base_art ON #art_base (ART);

  CREATE TABLE #art_keys (
    ART NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
  );

  INSERT INTO #art_keys (ART)
  SELECT DISTINCT ART
  FROM #art_base
  WHERE ART <> N'';

  CREATE TABLE #cmov_vtas (
    CLSM FLOAT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
  );

  INSERT INTO #cmov_vtas (CLSM)
  SELECT DISTINCT CMOV
  FROM dbo.DAT_CMOV
  WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(RELACION, N'')))) = N'VTAS'
    AND CMOV IS NOT NULL;

  CREATE TABLE #stock (
    ART NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    STOCK FLOAT NOT NULL
  );

  INSERT INTO #stock (ART, STOCK)
  SELECT
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), m.ART),
    SUM(ISNULL(m.CTDA, 0)) AS STOCK
  FROM dbo.DAT_MB51 m
  INNER JOIN #art_keys k ON k.ART = m.ART
  WHERE m.SUC = @sucMov
  GROUP BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), m.ART);

  CREATE TABLE #ventas (
    ART NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    VTA_90 FLOAT NOT NULL
  );

  INSERT INTO #ventas (ART, VTA_90)
  SELECT
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), m.ART),
    SUM(ISNULL(m.CTDA, 0) * -1) AS VTA_90
  FROM dbo.DAT_MB51 m
  INNER JOIN #art_keys k ON k.ART = m.ART
  INNER JOIN #cmov_vtas v ON v.CLSM = m.CLSM
  WHERE m.SUC = @sucMov
    AND m.FCND >= @fechaDesde
    AND m.FCND < @fechaHasta
  GROUP BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), m.ART);

  ;WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(
        ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(jd.DDEPA)), N'') + N' ', N''),
        ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(js.DSUBD)), N'') + N' ', N''),
        ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(jc.DCLAS)), N'') + N' ', N''),
        ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(jsc.DSCLA)), N'') + N' ', N''),
        ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(js2.DSCLA2)), N''), N'')
      ))) AS DESCRIPCION_LARGA_JERARQUIA,
      a.*,
      ISNULL(s.STOCK, 0) AS STOCK,
      ISNULL(v.VTA_90, 0) AS VTA_90
    FROM #art_base a
    LEFT JOIN #stock s ON s.ART = a.ART
    LEFT JOIN #ventas v ON v.ART = a.ART
    LEFT JOIN dbo.JRQ_DEPA jd ON jd.DEPA = a.DEPA
    LEFT JOIN dbo.JRQ_SUBD js ON js.SUBD = a.SUBD AND js.DEPA = a.DEPA
    LEFT JOIN dbo.JRQ_CLAS jc ON jc.CLAS = a.CLAS AND jc.SUBD = a.SUBD
    LEFT JOIN dbo.JRQ_SCLA jsc ON jsc.SCLA = a.SCLA AND jsc.CLAS = a.CLAS
    LEFT JOIN dbo.JRQ_SCLA2 js2 ON js2.SCLA2 = a.SCLA2 AND js2.SCLA = a.SCLA
  ),
  proveedor AS (
    SELECT b.*, p.NIVEL_PROV, p.NPROV, p.CTO
    FROM base b
    CROSS APPLY (VALUES
      (1, TRY_CONVERT(INT, b.PROV_1), b.CTO_PROV1),
      (2, TRY_CONVERT(INT, b.PROV_2), b.CTO_PROV2),
      (3, TRY_CONVERT(INT, b.PROV_3), b.CTO_PROV3)
    ) p(NIVEL_PROV, NPROV, CTO)
    WHERE p.NPROV IS NOT NULL
      AND p.CTO IS NOT NULL
      AND (@PROV IS NULL OR p.NPROV = @PROV)
  ),
  calc AS (
    SELECT
      p.*,
      ROUND(p.VTA_90 / @DIAS, 4) AS FACT_VTA_P_D,
      CASE WHEN p.VTA_90 <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.STOCK / NULLIF(p.VTA_90 / @DIAS, 0), 2) END AS DIAS_INV
    FROM proveedor p
  ),
  sugerido AS (
    SELECT
      c.*,
      ROUND(c.DIA_REABASTO - c.DIAS_INV, 2) AS FAC_REAB,
      ROUND(CASE WHEN c.DIA_REABASTO - c.DIAS_INV <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((c.DIA_REABASTO - c.DIAS_INV) * c.FACT_VTA_P_D) / c.FACT_COMP END, 0) AS SUG
    FROM calc c
  ),
  final AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      CASE WHEN STOCK_MIN - STOCK <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE CEILING(STOCK_MIN - STOCK) / FACT_COMP END AS PEDIDO,
      CASE
        WHEN ESTATUS = 'NO RESURTIBLE' THEN 0
        WHEN ESTATUS = 'FIJO' THEN CASE WHEN STOCK_MIN - (STOCK / FACT_COMP) <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE CEILING(STOCK_MIN - (STOCK / FACT_COMP)) END
        WHEN STOCK < STOCK_MIN AND (FAC_REAB <= 0 OR SUG <= 0) THEN CEILING(STOCK_MIN - STOCK)
        WHEN FAC_REAB <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN SUG <= 0 THEN 0
        ELSE CEILING(SUG)
      END AS CANT_FINAL_COMPRA
    FROM sugerido
  ),
  paged AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(1) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NPROV, DES, ART) AS RN
    FROM final
    WHERE CANT_FINAL_COMPRA > 0
  )
  SELECT
    TOTAL_COUNT,
    DESCRIPCION_LARGA_JERARQUIA,
    SUC,
    TIPO,
    ART,
    UPC,
    DES,
    BASE,
    SPH,
    CYL,
    ADIC,
    STOCK,
    STOCK_MIN,
    ESTATUS,
    DIA_REABASTO,
    PVTA,
    CTOP,
    NPROV,
    NIVEL_PROV,
    CTO,
    UN_COMP,
    FACT_COMP,
    VTA_90,
    FACT_VTA_P_D,
    DIAS_INV,
    FAC_REAB,
    SUG,
    PEDIDO,
    CANT_FINAL_COMPRA AS PED,
    CANT_FINAL_COMPRA,
    TRY_CONVERT(MONEY, CANT_FINAL_COMPRA * CTO) AS IMPORTE
  FROM paged
  WHERE RN > @offset
    AND RN <= @offset + @LIMIT
  ORDER BY RN
  OPTION (RECOMPILE);
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_cg_opv_pendiente_transacciones
  @SUC VARCHAR(25),
  @FCN DATE,
  @OPV NVARCHAR(255),
  @TIPO_CORTE VARCHAR(10) = 'GLOBAL'
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @sucNorm VARCHAR(25) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@SUC, ''))));
  DECLARE @opvNorm NVARCHAR(255) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@OPV, ''))));
  DECLARE @tipoNorm VARCHAR(10) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@TIPO_CORTE, 'GLOBAL'))));
  DECLARE @fcnDate DATE = ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, @FCN), CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(datetime, dbo.fn_ioe_business_datetime(SYSUTCDATETIME()))));
  DECLARE @dtIni DATETIME = CAST(@fcnDate AS DATETIME);
  DECLARE @dtFin DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @dtIni);

  IF @tipoNorm NOT IN ('CA', 'VF', 'GLOBAL')
    SET @tipoNorm = 'GLOBAL';

  IF @sucNorm = ''
    THROW 58080, 'SUC es obligatorio', 1;

  IF @opvNorm = ''
    THROW 58081, 'OPV es obligatorio', 1;

  ;WITH FoliosBase AS (
    SELECT
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.OPVM, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL THEN a.OPVM
          ELSE a.OPV
        END,
      '')))) AS OPV,
      a.IDFOL,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ORIGEN_AUT, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL THEN a.ORIGEN_AUT
          ELSE a.AUT
        END,
      '')))) AS AUT,
      UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.ESTA, '')))) AS ESTA,
      ISNULL(a.IMPT, 0) AS TOTAL,
      a.FCNM
    FROM dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_FORM f
    INNER JOIN dbo.PV_CTR_FOL_ASVR a
      ON a.IDFOL = f.IDFOL
    WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(a.SUC, '')))) = @sucNorm
      AND f.FCN >= @dtIni
      AND f.FCN < @dtFin
  ),
  Folios AS (
    SELECT
      fb.OPV,
      fb.IDFOL,
      fb.AUT,
      fb.ESTA,
      fb.TOTAL,
      fb.FCNM
    FROM FoliosBase fb
    WHERE fb.OPV = @opvNorm
      AND fb.AUT NOT IN ('CP', 'CPF', 'VA')
      AND (
        @tipoNorm = 'GLOBAL'
        OR (@tipoNorm = 'CA' AND fb.AUT = 'CA')
        OR (@tipoNorm = 'VF' AND fb.AUT = 'VF')
      )
    GROUP BY fb.OPV, fb.IDFOL, fb.AUT, fb.ESTA, fb.TOTAL, fb.FCNM
  )
  SELECT
    f.OPV,
    f.IDFOL,
    f.AUT,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.[DESC], ''))), ''), f.AUT) AS AUT_DESC,
    f.ESTA,
    f.TOTAL,
    f.FCNM,
    @tipoNorm AS TIPO_CORTE
  FROM Folios f
  LEFT JOIN dbo.PV_TIPO_ESTA t
    ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.TIPO, '')))) = f.AUT
  ORDER BY f.FCNM, f.IDFOL;
END;
